title: Tillbase sponsor manifest
description: The list of sponsor messages the app may show. One static file, reviewed through pull requests. scripts/validate-ads.mjs checks everything here and more (banned words, image size, dates that make sense, unique ids); it also reads the limits and the category list from this file, so they are written down only once.

version.description: Shape version. The app ignores a manifest whose version it does not know.

updated.description: Day this file was last changed.

footer.description: Messages for the slim line at the bottom of the window. Empty means nothing is shown.

sponsor.description: Who is paying, as it should be shown.

text.description: The message. Plain text, at most 90 characters.

image.description: Optional. https link to a still PNG or WebP, at most 600x100 pixels and 100 KB. No query string. No animation.

url.description: Where a click goes. https only.

category.description: Only businesses that help a shop or restaurant run.

start.description: First day it may be shown (inclusive).

end.description: Last day it may be shown (inclusive). Not before start.

weight.description: How often it is picked compared with the others in the same slot.
